items.heading: That Expectation Is Not Unreasonable
items.text: That expectation is not unreasonable - these are real, large, long-running employers - but it can crowd out an honest look at whether that specific track fits the person, or whether it is simply the path nobody in the family ever had reason to question.

items.heading: The Maharaja Sayajirao University
items.text: The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda's Faculty of Technology and Engineering feeds directly into this pipeline, so a technical student here can go from classroom to PSU-track expectation without ever formally weighing the alternative.
